sections.headline: Common Questions
sections.interactivity: FAQ accordion with smooth height transitions and auto-close on other items.

items.title: Is my banking data secure?
items.description: Yes. We use Plaid for bank connections, meaning we never see or store your login credentials. Your data is encrypted with AES-256.

items.title: What are the transaction fees?
items.description: Levin doesn't take a cut of your payments. You only pay the standard Stripe processing fees (typically 2.9% + 30c).

items.title: Can I use my own branding?
items.description: Absolutely. You can upload your logo, choose your brand colors, and customize the email templates sent to your clients.
